facts.text: An emergency stop on off-road machinery can itself create danger through unstable load behaviour, loss of traction or control, articulation, interaction with a following machine or operator counteraction; this hazard is absent from most passenger-car AEB discussions.
facts.quote: an emergency stop can itself create danger through unstable load behaviour, loss of traction or control, articulation, interaction with a following machine or operator counteraction.

facts.text: The danger created by an emergency stop on off-road machinery varies by machine and operation.
facts.quote: The risk varies by machine and operation

facts.text: The danger created by an emergency stop on off-road machinery should be included in the hazard analysis rather than assuming the stop is safe because the system stops sooner.
facts.quote: belongs in the hazard analysis rather than being assumed safe because the system "stops sooner".
